entries.title: Dioxus 0.7 — Native rendering, hot-patching, fullstack overhaul
entries.note: Released September 8, 2025. Introduces Dioxus Native (WGPU + Blitz), Subsecond Rust hot-patching, Axum-based fullstack with SSE/WebSocket/file streaming, Stores for nested reactive state. Blitz still 'work in progress'.

entries.title: Release Dioxus v0.7.0 — DioxusLabs/dioxus
entries.note: Canonical release notes for 0.7.0.

entries.title: dioxus 0.7.9 on docs.rs
entries.note: Latest stable point release as of May 2026 — 0.7.9.

entries.title: DioxusLabs/dioxus on GitHub
entries.note: MIT/Apache-2.0 dual license. 36.1k stars, 1.7k forks as of May 2026. Sponsored by FutureWei, Satellite.im, GitHub Accelerator. Targets web, desktop, mobile, SSR, liveview.

entries.title: Dioxus 0.7 docs — Desktop platform
entries.note: Desktop platform runs on Wry/Tao WebView (same engine as Tauri). Dioxus desktop is essentially a thin Tauri-shaped wrapper, not a separate renderer.

entries.title: DioxusLabs/blitz — A radically modular HTML/CSS rendering engine
entries.note: Native renderer used by Dioxus Native. Built on Stylo (Firefox), Taffy, Vello. Self-described as pre-alpha — 'still many bugs and missing features. Performance has not been a focus.'

entries.title: dioxus-native on crates.io
entries.note: Crate that paints Dioxus apps entirely on the GPU via Blitz.

entries.title: Blitz CSS support matrix
entries.note: Live matrix of which CSS features Blitz supports. Significant gaps remain — incorrect writing direction, layout quirks, missing event types (mouseover, forms), input widget types.

entries.title: Dioxus 0.7 — Axum Router (fullstack)
entries.note: Dioxus Fullstack is built on Axum; provides SSE, WebSocket, streaming, typed forms, file upload/download, middleware natively.

entries.title: Dioxus 0.7 fullstack — Streaming and SSE
entries.note: TextStream and SSE primitives for streaming server-to-client data — directly relevant to log tailing and live updates from mcpd.

entries.title: Dioxus 0.7 — Hot reloading reference
entries.note: Two layers of hot reload: instant RSX/property reload (no rebuild) plus experimental Subsecond Rust hot-patching via `dx serve --hotpatch`.

entries.title: Hot Reloading in Rust? Subsecond and Dioxus to the rescue!
entries.note: February 2026 deep dive on Subsecond — incremental linking / binary patching for live Rust edits. First Rust framework to ship this.

entries.title: dioxus-cli (dx) on crates.io
entries.note: Unified CLI: `dx new`, `dx serve`, `dx bundle`, `dx serve --hotpatch`. Produces .app/.dmg/.deb/.AppImage outputs.

entries.title: Dioxus 0.7 — Bundling apps
entries.note: Bundle macOS .app + .dmg, Linux .deb + .AppImage via --package-types flag.

entries.title: Tauri 2.0 Stable Release
entries.note: GA Oct 2, 2024. Capabilities/permissions ACL, mobile targets, new IPC via custom protocols, tauri::ipc::Channel for streaming.

entries.title: tauri-apps/tauri on GitHub
entries.note: MIT/Apache-2.0 dual license.

entries.title: Tauri 2 — Embedding External Binaries (Sidecar)
entries.note: First-class sidecar API for managing daemon child processes — the obvious path for shipping mcpd alongside the GUI.

entries.title: IPC Pipe vs Unix Socket for a Resident Daemon in Tauri
entries.note: Practical write-up on choosing stdin/stdout pipes vs Unix domain sockets for talking to a resident daemon from Tauri.

entries.title: Tauri plugins — SSE feature request (#1002)
entries.note: Open issue for first-class SSE support in Tauri plugins. Community crate tauri-plugin-sse exists but is not official.

entries.title: Tauri 2 HTTP plugin
entries.note: First-party Rust-backed HTTP client. Plus EventSource works natively from the WebView frontend for SSE.

entries.title: tauri-plugin-keyring (HuakunShen)
entries.note: Community plugin wrapping the Rust `keyring` crate — macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service. Stronghold is deprecated in v3.

entries.title: Tauri vs Electron — bundle size and runtime trade-offs
entries.note: Tauri installers ~600KB–10MB vs Electron 80–150MB; idle RAM ~30–50MB.

entries.title: Desdaemon/tauri-dioxus — Dioxus integration with Tauri
entries.note: Community template that uses Dioxus as the WASM frontend inside a Tauri shell. Not officially supported by either project.

entries.title: Are there plans to integrate Dioxus and Tauri? (Tauri discussion #9169)
entries.note: Tauri maintainers' position: Dioxus has its own desktop runner using Wry/Tao, so no official create-tauri-app template. Mixing is community-supported.

entries.title: boringcactus — A 2025 Survey of Rust GUI Libraries
entries.note: Of 43 libraries tested, only 4 (Slint, egui, Dioxus, WinSafe) passed minimal a11y+IME label test. Dioxus inherits WebView a11y for free.

entries.title: Leptos vs Dioxus — Rust Frontend Framework in 2026
entries.note: 2026 framing: Leptos is web-fullstack focused; Dioxus is multi-target (web, desktop, mobile, TUI).

entries.title: Launch YC: Dioxus Labs — Web, Desktop, Mobile with one codebase
entries.note: YC-funded company. Listed customers/users: Huawei, Airbus + ESA collision-avoidance system, Satellite.im (peer-to-peer Discord competitor).

entries.title: Dioxus 0.7 Roadmap — Discussion #3523
entries.note: Public roadmap doc tracking pre-1.0 work.

entries.title: Experiences with Dioxus liveview — Discussion #3378
entries.note: Team has been deprioritizing liveview; recommends Fullstack instead. Liveview may be dropped in a future release.

entries.title: tauri-plugin-keychain on docs.rs
entries.note: Alternative plugin using native macOS Keychain Services directly.
